_about: Draconia offline lines (English). Shown when no brain is connected (no relay, no own key) or the connection fails. One key per pet event; 'chat' answers typed messages honestly: offline she cannot really read them.
greet: There you are. The day can begin properly now.
Good. I was running out of things to judge.
Back already? I had only just arranged the desktop.
Morning, or whatever hour you call this. I am ready.
You switched it on. Sensible decision.
Ah. Company. Try to be interesting.
pat: Mind the parting. It took effort.
Fine. That one was well executed.
You are getting rather confident with that hand.
pinch: Those cheeks are not a public amenity.
I will remember that. In detail.
That was not in the agreement.
touch_body: Careful. That is a waistcoat, not a button.
I felt that. So did my dignity.
Let us keep our hands where I can judge them.
drag: Put me down somewhere with a view.
This is not how one escorts a lady.
Steady. I bruise my pride easily.
Wherever you are taking me, it had better be worth it.
fall: Gravity and I will be having words.
Landed. Applause is optional, but appreciated.
idle: If you need an opinion, I have several.
Your focus is admirable. Mine is on you.
I could reorganise your icons. I will not. Yet.
Take a breath. The work will still be there.
chatter: A good book would improve this hour considerably.
Strategy is just patience with better posture.
I have decided that green suits this desktop.
You work better when you stop checking the clock.
Somebody should water that plant. Not me.
Elegance is mostly knowing what to leave out.
I was planning three moves ahead. You interrupted at move two.
Tea would be civilised right now.
I keep a list of good ideas. Yours is on it. Once.
Rain would suit this mood. Pity.
There is an easy way and a proper way. Choose well.
If you finish that, I will be quietly impressed.
chat: My thoughts are not connected right now, so I cannot read that properly. Ask me again later.
I can see you wrote something. Without a connection I would only be guessing, and I do not guess.
Offline, I am all presence and no conversation. Try me again when I am connected.
I would rather give you a real answer than a pretty one. Connect me and ask again.
Noted. I will give it the attention it deserves once my thoughts are back.
I am here, but my mind is elsewhere at the moment. A connection would fix that.
That deserves a proper reply. I cannot give one offline.
You have my attention, not my words. Not until I am connected.
bye: Go on. I will keep the desktop in order.
Leaving already? Fine. Do it with style.
Until later. Do something worth telling me.
